body:
## Why

Claude Code saves the request it builds for a session, the system prompt with the tools, as a `prompt_snapshot` line in the session's transcript. A resumed session sends that saved copy again, instead of the `systemPrompt` and tools the app passes in. Every turn after a session's first resumes it (`src/agent/coordinator.ts`, `coordinatorOptions`). So a session keeps the coordinator's instructions and tools from its first turn, and a deployed change to them reaches only sessions started after it.

That makes agent behavior hard to trace. A turn's trace names the commit the app ran (`metadata.commit`), but the model ran on the instructions of whatever commit started the session. A behavior change after a deploy may be missing from trips already under way, with nothing in the trace that says why.

Found in #209: the saving replays resume recorded sessions, and every replay ran on the instructions the session was recorded with. The first input of each turn had the same token count before and after a 5,700-character change to the instructions. `src/turn-run/recorded-turn.ts` now leaves the snapshots out of a run's copy of the transcript. A run of case 4.10 then wrote a new snapshot with the new instructions.

## Open questions

1. Should a live session pick up the instructions and tools of the code that runs each turn? One way is what `recorded-turn.ts` does: leave the snapshot lines out when the transcript is loaded for a resume, and give the line after each one the snapshot's parent. A session's prompt cache would be rebuilt after each deploy that changes them. The other is to keep it as it is, and say in technical spec 5.2 that a session keeps its first turn's instructions.

## Do

- Confirm it in the app: change the coordinator's instructions locally, resume a session started before the change with `npm run chat`, and check its transcript for a new `prompt_snapshot`, and the first model call's input tokens in the trace.

## Done when

- Open question 1 is settled, and the app does what it says.
- `npm run check` passes.

## Ends in

A PR, or a decision written in technical spec 5.2.

## Settled in

Chat.
